title: FOV-Control
description: Basic FOV Controller that let's you choose what affects your FOV
body:
# FOV Effects Control

**FOV Effects Control is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that lets you choose which gameplay effects are allowed to change your field of view.**

Minecraft normally gives you one global “FOV Effects” slider, which affects everything at once.

This mod splits those effects into separate Mod Menu toggles, so you can keep the FOV changes you like and disable the ones you do not.

## Features

Toggle the whole mod on or off

Choose whether sprinting affects FOV

Choose whether Speed affects FOV

Choose whether Slowness affects FOV

Choose whether flying affects FOV

Choose whether bow drawing affects FOV

Choose whether spyglass zoom affects FOV

Choose whether other movement modifiers affect FOV

Configurable through Mod Menu

Client-side only

### Requirements:

Fabric Loader

Fabric API

Cloth Config

Mod Menu

## Notes

This mod does not change server behavior and only affects your own client-side camera/FOV calculation.
